sources.title: slimsam-77-uniform Open-source Segmentation Model - Compressed SAM with ...
sources.snippet: Model Overview SlimSAM is a compressed version based on the Segment Anything Model (SAM), capable of generating high-quality object masks from input prompts like points or boxes. Through an innovative pruning-distillation framework, it achieves performance close to the original SAM with extremely low training costs.
